snippet.title: Blasterbug: Last Bug Standing! | Available NOW
snippet.description:
Blasterbug: Last Bug Standing! is available NOW for free on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3069340/Blasterbug_Last_Bug_Standing

Welcome to Blasterbug: Last Bug Standing! a chaotic bomb-em-up party game inspired by the arcade classics we all love!
Throw out explosive Pome-grenades and punch out your opponents to become the ultimate bug! Be careful not to get caught in the blast as you navigate evolving arenas, or you might end up as just another splatter on the arcade wall.

🐜 Play as 15 colorful ant-stoppable bugs with their dedicated special moves!
🪲 Beetle your way into 15 playable areas, each bringing their own gameplay twist!
🎮 5 game modes available: last-bug standing “Death Battle,” richest-bug-wins “Coin Battle,” hold on to your hat “Crown Battle,” splatter-spreading “Paint Battle” and the ultimate mix it up “Party Battle” combining all of them together with random modifiers.
👥 Local multiplayer up to 8 players!

Time to bring your hive-mates and see who’s gonna bee the last bug standing!

© 2026 Dotemu.
